# The Git block, driven through its own page (tests/run.sh makes the
# repository at @REPO@: two commits, an edited file, a new one).
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
type:cd @REPO@
key:enter
wait:0.6
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:git
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Git
key:enter
wait:1.0
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Git — gitblock
expect-page:Changes
expect-page:app.swift
expect-page:notes.txt
# A file's diff, and one hunk staged on its own.
page-click:app.swift
wait:0.6
expect-page:Stage Hunk
expect-page:let answer = 42
page-click:Stage Hunk
wait:0.8
expect-page:Staged
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ diff --cached --name-only ==> app.swift
# Commit it with a message of two lines.
page-type:textarea=Answer the question
page-click:Commit 1
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ log -1 --format=%s ==> Answer the question
expect-page-not:Staged
# The history shows it, with its diff.
page-click:History
wait:0.6
expect-page:Answer the question
expect-page:Second
page-click:Answer the question
wait:0.6
expect-page:let answer = 42
# A new branch from the Branches list.
page-click:Branches
wait:0.5
expect-page:main
page-click:New Branch…
wait:0.3
page-type:.dialog .field=feature-x
page-click:Create
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ branch --show-current ==> feature-x
# Stash what's left, and pop it back.
page-click:Stashes
wait:0.4
page-click:Stash Changes…
wait:0.3
page-type:.dialog .field=probe stash
page-click:Stash
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ stash list ==> probe stash
expect-page:probe stash
page-click:probe stash
wait:0.5
page-click:Pop (apply and drop)
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ stash list | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ status --porcelain ==> notes.txt
# A command in a terminal shows up: back on main.
tab:1
type:git switch -q main
key:enter
wait:1.5
tab:2
page-click:Changes
wait:0.6
expect-page:main
shot:git-block.png
# A file named * is that file: discarding it leaves the other new one.
shell:cd @REPO@ && printf x > '*' && printf y > keep.txt
page-click:Refresh
wait:0.8
page-click:css:.row[title="*"] button[title="Discard Changes"]
wait:0.4
expect-page:Discard changes in *?
page-click:css:.dialog .button.primary
wait:1.0
expect-shell:cd @REPO@ && ls ==> keep.txt
expect-shell:cd @REPO@ && test -e '*' || echo gone ==> gone
# A name beyond ASCII reads as itself (not "caf\303\251.txt").
shell:cd @REPO@ && printf 'accent\n' > café.txt
page-click:Refresh
wait:0.8
expect-page:café.txt
page-click:café.txt
wait:0.6
expect-page:accent
# A staged rename unstages whole: both its paths leave the index.
shell:cd @REPO@ && git mv app.swift main.swift
page-click:Refresh
wait:0.8
page-click:css:.row[title="app.swift → main.swift"] button[title="Unstage"]
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
shell:cd @REPO@ && mv main.swift app.swift
# A conflict: shown as both sides, settled with theirs, and the merge committed.
shell:cd @REPO@ && git switch -q -c side && printf 'side\n' > c.txt && git add c.txt && git commit -qm side && git switch -q main && printf 'main\n' > c.txt && git add c.txt && git commit -qm main-c && (git merge side > /dev/null 2>&1; true)
page-click:Refresh
wait:0.8
expect-page:Conflicts
expect-page:Merging
page-click:c.txt
wait:0.6
expect-page:(conflicted)
expect-page:<<<<<<<
shot:git-conflict.png
page-click:Use Theirs
wait:0.4
page-click:css:.dialog .button.primary
wait:1.0
expect-shell:cat @REPO@/c.txt ==> side
expect-page-not:Conflicts
page-type:textarea=Merge side
page-click:css:.commit-box .button.primary
wait:1.0
expect-shell:git -C @REPO@ log -1 --format=%P | wc -w | tr -d ' ' ==> 2
